jei.averiummod.info.raw_crython.line1: Obtained by mining Crython Ore or Deepslate Crython Ore.
jei.averiummod.info.raw_crython.line2: Requires a Diamond-tier Pickaxe or stronger.
jei.averiummod.info.raw_crython.line3: Found in cold biomes at deep Y-levels.
jei.averiummod.info.crython_slow: Inflicts slowness on the player when in inventory without a Frost Ebber. Stabilise to remove this effect.
jei.averiummod.info.stable_crython: Stabilised Crython, no longer inflicts slowness on the player when in inventory.
jei.averiummod.info.crython_ore.drops: Drops Raw Crython when mined with a Diamond-tier Pickaxe or stronger. Found in cold biomes.
jei.averiummod.info.deepslate_crython_or: Drops Raw Crython when mined with a Diamond-tier Pickaxe or stronger. Found in cold biomes.
jei.averiummod.info.crython_ore.info: Slows the player in a radius, and applies Mining Fatigue when mined. Nullified by Frost Ebber.
jei.averiummod.info.raw_infernium.line2: Requires a Diamond-tier Pickaxe or stronger.
jei.averiummod.info.infernium_burn: Periodically sets the player ablaze when in inventory without an Obsidian Stake. Stabilise to remove this effect.
jei.averiummod.info.stable_infernium: Stabilised Infernium, no longer sets the player ablaze when in inventory.
jei.averiummod.info.infernium_ore.drops: Drops Raw Infernium when mined with a Diamond-tier Pickaxe or stronger. Found in the Nether.
jei.averiummod.info.infernium_ore.info: Periodically sets the player ablaze within a radius of it. Nullified by Obsidian Stake.
jei.averiummod.info.frost_ebber: Nullifies the effects of raw and unstable Crython in the inventory and its corresponding ores when equipped as a Charm.
jei.averiummod.info.obsidian_stake: Nullifies the effects of raw and unstable Infernium in the inventory and its corresponding ore when equipped as a Charm.
jei.averiummod.info.gold_reinforced_stic: A stick reinforced with gold. Used for Argon Treatment.
jei.averiummod.info.gas_cell.info: A specialised container for gases. Usable on natural vents.
jei.averiummod.info.argon_gas_cell.line1: Obtained by right-clicking an active Argon Vent with an empty Glass Bottle.
jei.averiummod.info.argon_gas_cell.line2: Used in specialized material crafting processes.
jei.averiummod.info.argon_vent.interacti: Right-click with a Gas Cell to collect a Argon Gas Cell when active. May cause nausea.
jei.averiummod.info.xenon_gas_cell.line1: Obtained by right-clicking an active Xenon Vent with an empty Glass Bottle.
jei.averiummod.info.xenon_gas_cell.line2: Used in specialized charm crafting processes.
jei.averiummod.info.xenon_vent.interacti: Right-click with a Gas Cell to collect a Xenon Gas Cell when active. May cause poison.
jei.averiummod.info.xenon_matrix.info: An empty Xenon Matrix. Unusable on its own until it is filled with Xenon.
jei.averiummod.info.charged_xenon_matrix: A charged Xenon Matrix. Used to make specialised charms to combat the side effects of Averium metals.
